official.deadline_note: The published application period ran from October 13, 2025 to December 10, 2025; that window has passed and no next-cycle date is published.
official.status_note: The published 2026 application period closed on December 10, 2025; no new dates are published on the ISO page.
official.tuition_coverage_note: Exemption from tuition fee, providing free on-campus accommodation or providing accommodation subsidy, Comprehensive Medical Insurance
benefits: Free on-campus accommodation or accommodation subsidy
eligibility: Master's applicants: holders of a bachelor's degree under the age of 35
Doctoral applicants: holders of a master's degree under the age of 40
Not holding any other scholarship provided by the Chinese government
requirements: Download, print, fill out and sign the Shanghai Government Scholarship application form from the ISO website
Complete the Fudan application choosing 'Self-support' as the fund source and select the 'Shanghai Government Scholarship' option
Upload the completed Foreigner Physical Examination Form
documents: Completely filled Foreigner Physical Examination Form, filled out in Chinese or English, valid for six months
The signed Shanghai Government Scholarship application form downloaded from the ISO website
coverage: Free on-campus accommodation or accommodation subsidy
application_method: Step One: visit https://iso.fudan.edu.cn/16053/list.htm to download the application form; print, fill out and sign it
Step Two: visit https://istudent.fudan.edu.cn/apply to complete the application, choosing 'Self-support' as the fund source
When filling in the application form, choose the option of 'Shanghai Government Scholarship' and upload the scholarship application form
Upload the completely filled Foreigner Physical Examination Form (applicants residing in China may submit a Residence Permit or Foreign Permanent Resident ID Card instead)
official.application_route: Download and sign the scholarship form, apply at istudent.fudan.edu.cn as 'Self-support' and select the Shanghai Government Scholarship option, then upload the signed form.
official.description: The Shanghai Government Scholarship supports international master's and doctoral students at Fudan University with tuition exemption, free on-campus accommodation or an accommodation subsidy, comprehensive medical insurance and a monthly living stipend.

applicant_utility.summary: Fudan's route into the Shanghai Government Scholarship is a single online application with one easily-missed step: you register as a self-support student, then switch the fund source to the Shanghai Government Scholarship option and upload the separately downloaded, signed form. The award covers tuition, on-campus accommodation or a subsidy, medical insurance and a 3,000 RMB monthly stipend for master's students (3,500 for doctoral). Applications for the 2026 intake closed on 10 December 2025, so watch the ISO site for the next window.
applicant_utility.best_fit: International master's and doctoral applicants to Fudan who want a straightforward, single-form municipal scholarship route.
application_readiness_checklist: Download the scholarship form from the ISO page before starting the online application
Register at istudent.fudan.edu.cn and choose 'Self-support' as the fund source so the scholarship option is available
Upload the printed, completed and signed scholarship form - not just the online data
Book the Foreigner Physical Examination Form within six months of applying
Apply inside the published window (for the 2026 round: October 13 to December 10, 2025)
common_rejection_risks: Forgetting to tick the Shanghai Government Scholarship option, leaving you as a fee-paying self-support student
Uploading an unsigned or incomplete scholarship form
An expired physical examination form (valid for six months only)
Missing the published window entirely - there is no rolling admission
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Personal spending, international travel and visa costs sit outside the published coverage.
document_audit: The scholarship application form is a separate download (iso.fudan.edu.cn/16053/list.htm) that must be printed, signed and scanned back in
Applicants already in China can substitute a Residence Permit or Foreign Permanent Resident ID Card for the physical examination form
alerts: You cannot hold another Chinese government scholarship at the same time
Late arrival on the registration date without approval in advance automatically cancels the scholarship
Annual evaluation is mandatory; failing it ends the award
The major and study period cannot be changed once enrolled
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: One online application at istudent.fudan.edu.cn with the signed scholarship form uploaded; results are checked in the 'Notices' column of the ISO website.
